implementation_notes: The minimal lock-free ring for one producer and one consumer: each side writes only its own index, so no CAS and no lock, only an acquire load of the opposite index and a release store of one's own. Requires unsafe for the uninitialised slots, so model it with MaybeUninit and a ManuallyDrop'd pop.
code_sketch: self.head.store(h + 1, Ordering::Release); // after writing the slot
pitfalls: The unsafe slot handling is the risk; a safe Vec<Option<T>> costs a branch per access.
Without cache-line padding the ping-pong dominates.

variants.name: crossbeam ArrayQueue (lock-free bounded MPMC)
variants.implementation_notes: The maintained, audited, lock-free bounded ring for multiple producers and consumers, with a documented progress guarantee. The right default for MPMC; reach for the hand-written SPSC ring only on a measured single-producer path.
pitfalls: Bounded: push returns Err when full, so the policy is explicit.
